title: Nonzero one-window common-chirp phase eliminant
exact_claim:
For r≥1, N≥3r, F_p containing supplied ω of exact order N, a nonzero x_j=ω^(aj²)sum_(ℓ=1)^s c_ℓω^(b_ℓj), s≤r, has a nonzero center c in [r,N−r−1]. Put h=c−r.
P_h(t)=t^(−E)det[x_(h+i+j)t^binom(i+j,2)]_(i,j=0)^r is a polynomial, E=(r+1)r(r−1)/2. It has degree at most D=binom(r+2,3), constant coefficient (−1)^(r(r+1)/2)x_c^(r+1)≠0, and P_h(ω^(−2a))=0 for every valid phase.
There are at most min(D,N/gcd(2,N)) canonical phase candidates. For even N phases a and a+N/2 are equivalent after frequency translation. The all-zero input is rank-zero and must be handled separately.
model: Exact finite-field root-of-unity grid, bounded common chirp rank; N≥3r is a witness guarantee, not a universal identifiability threshold.
novelty_status: Specific certificate may be original; not cleared. Common-rate chirps, dechirping and Hankel/Prony are established.
proof_status: Accepted independent audit of the full recognition theorem; polynomial proof uses unique extremal determinant terms, not fitted degrees. Catalogue has inspected theorem/audit text; no source program executed.

title: Exact legal scalar chirp-resolvent bank minima
exact_claim:
For N=2m+1≥3, primitive q in characteristic zero, h=(N+1)/2, f(k)=q^(hk²), C=sum_(k=0)^(N−1)f(k)P^k, represent C=sum_(s=1)^Q a_s(I−λ_sP)^(−1), with a_s,λ_s≠0 and λ_s^N≠1. Without a free diagonal Qmin=m+1 for every odd N.
With δI free, Qmin=m iff T_m(z)=(-1)^mH_m(−z;q) has simple nonzero nonresonant roots; otherwise Qmin=m+1. An arbitrary free diagonal does not enlarge this scalar common-P circulant model.
T_m(0)=(-1)^m. gcd(T_m,z^N−1)=1 for N≡1 mod4 and z−1 for N≡3 mod4, the latter root simple. Thus all N≡3 mod4 have Qmin=m+1. Every prime N≡1 mod4 and the audited infinite families have Qmin=m.
When Qmin=m, δ=(-1)^m q^(−m(m+1)/2)product_(j=1)^m(1−q^j) is forced and nonzero. Nodes/weights may lie in an algebraic closure; root-free sum works over Q(q).
model: Scalar coefficients, same natural cycle P, first-order nonconfluent resolvents, no branch-dependent diagonal endpoints or independent routing.
novelty_status: Specific exact legal-bank classification potentially new as an application; finite-moment/Prony/Padé/formal-orthogonality ingredients classical. External novelty unconfirmed.
proof_status: Uniform construction/minimum and partial free-diagonal classification independently accepted. Nonsingular Hankel lower bound and guarded polynomial-pencil upper construction both checked.

title: Multiscale Weyl-support and dyadic chirp product barrier
exact_claim: For N=2^m≥4 and a primitive 2N-th root ζ, C[i,j]=ζ^((i−j)^2) has inverse coefficients q_t=ζ^(−t²)/N. Every literal product of pure-shift resolvents with arbitrary strides and Weyl-monomial gauges representing C needs L≥m+1. Equality L=m in the support count would force unique dyadic subset sums, contradicted by a chirp parallelogram ratio. More generally, Fourier inverse Weyl support is N² for odd N and N²/2 for even N, so products of denominators having q_j Weyl atoms need Πq_j at least that support. The binary reshape of q has rank 2^min(a,m−a).
model: Literal multiplicative Weyl/shift grammar with specified roots; arbitrary diagonal gauges excluded.
novelty_status: Unresolved worldwide priority; negative search results are not novelty proof.
proof_status: source theorem analytically inspected; independent audit pending

Fixed dyadic 0<epsilon<=1/4 or epsilon=2^-ceil((log2N)^beta), fixed0<beta<1: O_epsilon(Nlog N/loglog N) word ops,O(N) words. Efficiently supplied precision p=o(log N) yields o(Nlog N).
